sections.heading: Our team
sections.lead: The staff who run CECF day to day, and the board and advisors who govern and guide the consortium.

sections.body: The names and bios below are placeholder profiles for layout purposes only — not real CECF staff or board members. Replace every entry with verified information and consented headshots before this page goes live.

sections.note: PLACEHOLDER PROFILES — illustrative only, not real CECF personnel. See the note section above and media/photos/PLACEHOLDERS.md. Do not treat as real staff without written confirmation from CECF.
sections.heading: Staff
sections.lead: Our staff manage registration, field operations, partnerships and day-to-day programme delivery.

items.name: Wanjiru Kamau
items.bio: Leads CECF's overall strategy and represents the consortium to government, banks and donor partners.

items.name: Otieno Odhiambo
items.bio: Oversees the registration and formalisation programme, from field outreach to referral into banking and government services.

items.name: Achieng Njeri
items.bio: Manages CECF's relationships with ministries, regulators, banks and development partners.

items.name: Kiptoo Langat
items.bio: Coordinates the field officer network that supports groups through registration county by county.

items.name: Naliaka Wafula
items.bio: Oversees CECF's own financial management and compliance, and supports groups preparing for bank account opening.

items.name: Chebet Rono
items.bio: Runs community workshops and group trainings, and coordinates the training calendar with county partners.

items.name: Mutiso Kilonzo
items.bio: Manages CECF's communications, the digital registration platform, and this website.

sections.heading: Board & advisors
sections.lead: Our board provides oversight and governance; our advisors bring specialist expertise in government, banking and cooperative development.

items.name: Muthoni Gitau
items.bio: Chairs the board and provides strategic oversight of CECF's mission and governance.

items.name: Barasa Simiyu
items.bio: Supports the Chair and leads board oversight of programme delivery.

items.name: Adhiambo Owino
items.bio: Oversees CECF's finances and reporting on behalf of the board.

items.name: Cherono Kiprop
items.bio: Maintains board governance records and coordinates board meetings.

items.name: Njoroge Mwangi
items.bio: Advises the board on legal, regulatory and governance matters.

items.name: Auma Omondi
items.bio: Brings banking-sector experience to the board's oversight of financial-inclusion partnerships.

items.name: Korir Cheruiyot
items.bio: Advises on engagement with ministries, regulators and county government.

items.name: Nyambura Karanja
items.bio: Advises on cooperative structures and small-enterprise growth pathways for registered groups.
